headline: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) Stock Could Be 47% Overvalued Despite Higher Q3 Profit And Dividend
summary: Interactive Brokers Group has delivered very strong long term share gains, which puts extra attention on whether the current price is properly backed by the returns it earns on its capital. The recent pullback over the past month and week only sharpens that question for anyone trying to decide how much of that story is already reflected in the valuation. Over the past 5 years the stock is up about 356%, which puts a lot of weight on the quality and durability of the returns Interactive...
